Why these conversations can feel difficult.

You may be unsure how to ask, worried about being misunderstood, or used to keeping these topics private. Berkeley UHS recognizes that conversations about sexual health can be challenging.

This project offers explanations and conversation stories to explore. The goal is to help you find language that fits your needs, while leaving room for another person's choice.
